name: Saki's Mother
source:
She is the mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c21995]Saki[/url] and the childhhod friend and wife of her [url=https://vndb.org/c69700]husband[/url].

[spoiler]Her husband ask her hand of to her father but because he wasn't from a noble bloodline he refuses.
In response, she fled with the elect of his heart and founded their family.

She is of weak physical composition and the birth of Saki almost killed her. 

She is currently hospitalized.[/spoiler]
